experiment_data.hypothesis: Temperature scaling reduces per-subgroup misclassification rates but does NOT eliminate heterogeneity (Δπ shrinks from 0.20 to 0.07 but remains nonzero), so EC-HTE is still necessary post-calibration. Calibrated+EC-HTE should achieve the best coverage.

metrics.key_finding: Calibration reduces Δπ from 0.20 to 0.07 and improves naive coverage (84.0%→91.2%) but doesn't reach nominal 95%. Calibrated+EC-HTE achieves best coverage (96.5%) — EC-HTE corrects residual heterogeneity post-calibration. Calibrated+Naive still under-covers by 3.8pp. EC-HTE and calibration are complementary, not substitutes.
